value: THE SCORE-INVISIBLE RELOC-IDENTITY POPULATION IS 124 FUNCTIONS OF THE 2713 THAT objdiff SCORES AT FUZZY 100 (4.6%), AND ONLY 5 OF THEM WERE EVER DEFECTS. Measured image-wide by tools/gdl/composed_census/rs_composed_census.py at commit 013032d83 over 256 units, one pass, three independent residual views per function (fndiff --count `real`; fndiff --clean over reloc-NORMALIZED text; the address-resolved relocation SET delta) plus a fourth POSITIONAL view this lane added. CLASS TABLE, and the class is what matters because the raw count is dominated by benign rows: NAMING_ONLY 57 - fndiff's own documented MATCH-MODULO-RELOC-NAMING plus pool-name noise, where our object emits an anonymous @N pool entry against a splitter-named symbol; link-equal, FINISHED, not work. RELOC_SET_DELTA 33 - the same anonymous-vs-named shape but where the two sides' symbol TEXT does not even normalize to a common key (MWCC's local-static mangling `atanhi$1`, `cmdTypeAndStatus$371`, `tbl3$222` against dtk's `lbl_80117FA0`); also benign, and the mangled suffix is the whole difference. SPELLING_DRIFT 33 - REFUTED as a defect class this run, see claim.law.RS_split-symbol-map-halves-a-64-bit-object-so-a-plus-4-addend-is-faithful.20260902.v1. WRONG_DATUM 4 - the only genuine defects, all four found by the POSITIONAL view and invisible to every other one. 13 of the 124 rows are WebFrank-PINNED, i.e. their source is frozen and the bytes scored are POSTPROCESSED; the census now labels them, after two of them were discovered only by a failed ninja. HEADLINE FOR THE NEXT LANE: the run-36 premise that this population is a large body of open reloc-identity work is FALSE - 90 of the 124 rows are benign by construction and a further 33 were refuted by measurement. The yield of the whole sweep is 4 real bugs, of which 3 are fixed (commits 03eefd674, 33ab771b7) and 1 is blocked behind a pin. Re-run cost is one command and roughly 6 minutes.
